system.description:
You gain a rank of Mastery in Stealth. When you take the Hide action, if you have a Weapon with the Thrown property and/or an explosive tool, you can, as part of the same action used to hide perform one of the following special abilities:

Tricky Escape. As part of the same action used to take the Hide action, you can set the explosive tool in a space you can reach. This does not count for explosive tools that take longer than an action to set or detonate. You can then spend 2 Discipline to detonate the explosive tool at any point before the beginning of your next turn. This does not reveal your location if you are unseen or hidden when detonated.

Parting Gift. As part of the same action used to take the Hide action, you can spend 2 Discipline to attach the explosive tool to a weapon with the Thrown property, and make a ranged weapon attack with it. It detonates on a hit. The attack occurs before the Hide action attempt so it does not reveal your location.
